lessons: Review approved the stages.py code: wiring, combining, cost sum and panel_facts logging. Redo it as the ticket describes. Two criterion-1 test gaps caused the snag, and both are in tests/unit/test_review_panel_use.py.

In test_single, parametrize over an unset route.panel and panel(route, 1). For both cases, assert that the whole result equals a hand-written StageResult("gate_failed", <expected SnagList>, [finding()], <expected Cost>). Checking only outcome, findings and artifact type does not satisfy criterion 1.

Parametrize test_single_effect_key over an unset route.panel and panel(route, 1). In both cases, assert that the only effect key is llm/item/0/review/1/1, with no m<k> scope. Criterion 1 requires the effect key check under a size-1 panel too.

Before finishing, check each clause of acceptance criterion 1 against a test that runs both the unset and size-1 cases: one driver.run call, zero run_panel calls, literal review.md text, full StageResult equality, effect key, and no panel_facts event.
